cohort: 260 patients diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus, aged >= 18 years, recruited between January 2019 and November 2021.
finding: Full or partial adherence to diet and/or therapy among GDM patients is associated with better glycaemic control during pregnancy, leading to a lower incidence of operative deliveries and reduced insulin utilization during pregnancy and labour.
mod_finding: Full or partial adherence was associated with a reduced risk of operative delivery.
